messages:
elaine: Heads-up — drafting the 2.1.0 changelog entry for the docs site. Need a short blurb for: streaming responses improvements, new 'private deployment' config snippets, and an entry for the known issue about embed rate limits.

sam: I can write the product blurbs. Can you paste the current bullet list so I don't duplicate?

elaine: Sure — copy below. Please trim to ~1 sentence each.
- streaming: improved stability and reconnect for chunked responses
- private deployment: added KMS/HSM config example and VPC networking note
- embeddings: observed temporary 429s for bulk requests; mitigation guidance added

mike: Quick doc note: the SDK snippet in the private deployment page still references old `client.create_private_deployment()` signature. PR #412 fixes it. We should mention migration steps for users upgrading from 2.0 -> 2.1.

olivia: Filed a tiny doc PR that updates the code example and adds a migration section. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/418. Could we include the snippet in the changelog as an example?

elaine: Yes, include a minimal snippet. Something like:
```
// JS SDK migration example
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.private.deploy({
  name: 'my-model',
  networking: { vpc: 'vpc-abc123', subnetIds: ['sub-1', 'sub-2'] },
  kmsKey: process.env.KMS_KEY
});
```
Keep it short in the changelog (link full example to the migration guide).

sam: For the embeddings 429 known issue, write: "Temporary rate limit observed for bulk embeddings (2024-11); retry with exponential backoff or split into smaller batches. We're working on capacity improvements." Sound good?

mike: Add a note that Dedicated customers can request higher quotas via support channel. Also, include a sample curl for backoff retries?

elaine: Good call. I'll add: "Dedicated customers: contact support for quota increases. See embedding-batching.md for retry patterns." And a tiny curl example?

olivia: Suggest removing deep tech details from the public changelog — keep it friendly for product users. Link to docs/developer/embedding-batching.md for details.

elaine: Agreed. Draft is ready. I'll open a docs PR with the changelog file + frontmatter. Tagging reviewers: @sam @mike.

docs-bot: New changelog PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/422 — reviewers requested: sam, mike.

sam: I'll review in the morning. Quick ask: can we include a "known issues" anchor so we can link it from support emails?

elaine: Done, adding `#known-issues` anchor. Final checklist before merge: short product blurbs, migration snippet truncated, link to migration guide, known issues anchor, support contact for Dedicated quotas, mention PR numbers.

mike: LGTM, will sanity-check code example for correctness.

elaine: Thanks. Merging after approvals.
